description: Visual Simulation Assistant — 15 trial + 8 real-customer scenarios. Top 5 recommended are 3–4 turn deep. Real customer pack = messy, short, mixed-language.

scenarios.title: Cancellation risk

turns.text: 这个英文 notice 说 payment failed，我现在怎么办？
我发了截图在微信
其实已经付了，但是账单上还显示due，是不是搞错了？那我现在最要紧做什么？

scenarios.notes: 3-turn: Turn 1 vague notice question; Turn 2 sent screenshot; Turn 3 clarifies payment confusion + asks what matters most. Handoff at turn 2; turn 3 shows clarification value. Proves urgency + broker handoff.

scenarios.title: Missing document

turns.text: UW follow up - need dec page + garaging proof. 上周发过了
declaration page 他又发了一次，garaging proof 还没弄
garaging proof 是什么意思？要发什么？

scenarios.notes: 3-turn: Turn 1 need dec+garaging, client said sent; Turn 2 clarifies dec resent, garaging missing; Turn 3 asks what garaging proof means + what to send. Handoff at turn 2; turn 3 shows clarification. Proves structured follow-up + verification clarity.

scenarios.title: Add-car quote (Chinese)

turns.text: 我买了台宝马X5，想问下保费多少钱
90210，下周提车。这些够了吗？

scenarios.notes: 3-turn: Turn 1 vague quote ask; Turn 2 year; Turn 3 zip+delivery + asks if enough. Proves multi-turn quote collection + Collected chips.

scenarios.title: Add car (English)

turns.text: I bought a new BMW X5, how much is insurance?
2024, 90210, picking up next week
I drive it myself

scenarios.notes: English add-car; T2 year+zip+delivery; T3 driver (deepening: ask driver at T2)

scenarios.title: Claim intake

turns.text: 刚出事故了，要收集什么？
对方跑了，我没拍照片，记了车牌
现在最要紧做什么？

scenarios.notes: 3-turn: Turn 1 accident; Turn 2 hit-and-run, no photos; Turn 3 asks what matters most. Handoff at turn 2; turn 3 shows next-step ask. Proves first-response guidance + collected/still-needed.

scenarios.title: Premium review

turns.text: 保费太高了，能不能便宜一点
续保通知和账单我发你微信了
能不能少一辆车便宜点？办公室先看什么？

scenarios.notes: 3-turn: Turn 1 premium too high; Turn 2 sent bill; Turn 3 asks if removing vehicle helps + what office reviews first. Handoff at turn 2; turn 3 shows retention follow-up. Proves retention-style follow-up.
